slides.title: More than coffee
slides.body:
*Fika* is a noun and a verb: you can have *en fika*, or you can just *fika*.

It's usually with other people, and many workplaces have set times for it. Tea or juice counts too.

caption:
Fika: a break for coffee (or tea) and something sweet, usually with other people. It's both a noun and a verb, so you can have a fika or simply fika.

Cinnamon buns, kanelbullar, are the classic choice. Sweden even has a Cinnamon Bun Day on 4 October.

What's your perfect fika?
